text:
kate (PM): ok team, quick sync. we need to finalize PRD acceptance criteria for the next model rollout and the experiment matrix. customer asks + constrained scope — proposing a small canary with tenant pinning + automated fallback. thoughts?

sanjay (Eng): +1 to tenant pinning. need to clarify: pin expiration, cache warming, and kv cache invalidation on rollback.

lina (CS): from customer side — they want a guaranteed fallback to current model for 100% of their traffic on rollback, not a slow ramp. they also require per-tenant logs for 30 days.

miguel (SRE): noted. ops constraints: if p95 latency increases by >200ms or error rate increases by 2x over baseline for 5m, trigger immediate rollback. does that align w/ product?

jess (Product Ops): propose acceptance criteria in PRD:
- behavioral parity checks on a 200-sample prompt set (>=95% stable outputs)
- infrastructure SLOs: p50 < 60ms, p95 < 350ms (canary), error rate < 0.5%
- rollback triggers: latency or error thresholds OR quality regression on eval set -> auto-fallback

kate (PM): agree. add: explicit version pin API that customer can call to opt into canary (tenant pin) and a server-side TTL (default 24h) with manual override for support. also add audit log requirement and a pin-expiration email to CS.

sanjay (Eng): implementation note: pin will be a metadata layer mapping tenant_id -> model_version with optional expiry. we should include quick config for experiment engine:
```yaml
experiment: v2_pin_and_fallback
phases:
  - name: tenant-canary
    traffic_allocation: 5%
    pin_mode: tenant_whitelist
    ttl_hours: 24
  - name: ramp
    traffic_allocation: 50%
    pin_mode: dynamic
    ttl_hours: 72
rollback_rules:
  - metric: p95_latency_ms
    action: rollback
    threshold: 200
    window_seconds: 300
  - metric: error_rate_pct
    action: rollback
    threshold_pct_increase: 100
    window_seconds: 300
```

miguel (SRE): that looks good. confirm: rollback action must immediately switch affected tenants to the pinned stable model and purge any KV cache entries for the new model to prevent stale state. we also need a safety cutoff where platform auto-degrades to smaller batch sizes and reduced model sequence length to reduce cost/latency before full rollback.

lina (CS): for customers with strict compliance, they want on-demand pinning via API and an SLA note that pinned traffic stays on older model until you unpin. we should add explicit UI copy for the Console to avoid confusion.

jess (Product Ops): acceptance tests: create a staged test harness that replays 10k representative requests, compare log-likelihood and token-delta against baseline, and run canary in prod for 24h with telemetry. if quality drops by >10% on our metric, block ramp.

sanjay (Eng): edge cases:
- tenant pinned to v2 but dependent feature flags expect v1 responses -> need compat shim or per-tenant feature gating.
- long-running streaming sessions mid-rollback -> should finish on old model or forcibly reconnect? prefer finish on old model.
- non-idempotent function calls in prompts -> must detect and mark experiments as unsafe

kate (PM): good list. add to PRD: "streaming sessions will be allowed to finish on the model they started on; new sessions use current routing." add a note: for customers requesting immediate cutoff, support can force reconnection but will flag as disruptive.

release-bot: deployment queued: canary (5%) -> 1802543400 by sanjay. status: pending approvals (sre, sec, cs).

miguel (SRE): approving pending if we have automated rollback wired up and alerting to oncall w/ runbook link.

sanjay (Eng): deploying now. will post logs and the quicktrace link.

ops-bot: canary deployed to k8s cluster gpu-pool-3 at 1802543445. traces: https://internal.redwood/trace/1802543445

kate (PM): follow-ups: jess to draft PRD acceptance checklist + UI copy, lina to draft customer comms for pinning behavior, sanjay to validate ttl behavior + cache purge tests, miguel to add runbook and pager rules. i'll consolidate and update PRD by EOD. :thumbsup:

jess (Product Ops): on it. will attach checklist to PRD and ping legal for audit log retention note.

lina (CS): I'll prepare customer email and sample API calls.

sanjay (Eng): posted canary metrics snapshot: p50=42ms, p95=180ms, error=0.12% at +30m. no rollback triggers so far.

miguel (SRE): looks healthy. monitoring alerts set. will escalate if thresholds hit.

kate (PM): great — thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for any late edge cases but will convert to PRD update once tasks are done.
